concerns.text: T101 requires model_results.json to 'conform to contracts/model_results_schema.schema.yaml' but its verification asserts `d['runs']` with per-run keys. That schema defines a single flat object (model_type, r2_test, feature_importance_ranking, ...) with NO `runs` array and `additionalProperties: false`; the runs-array structure lives in the differently-named `model_output_schema.yaml`. As written, T101's deliverable cannot both conform to the named schema and pass its own verification — a silent constraint contradiction that will force either schema relaxation or verification failure.

SC-004 ('Family-wise error rate is measured against a standard significance threshold after Benjamini-Hochberg correction') has no task and no verification step anywhere in tasks.md. FR-006's BH implementation is covered (T041/T042), but the SC-004 measurement/evidence criterion is dropped — an acceptance criterion silently lost between spec and tasks.

concerns.text: tasks.md marks as verified-complete a strict halt 'when neither conductivity nor HOMO-LUMO gap is available (no self-consistency fallback)', while plan.md mandates an empirical target-proxy fallback (target_proxy.py, T017) and a Self-Consistency Validation reframing. The tasks document unilaterally drops a plan-mandated component without reconciling the plan; either the plan must be amended or a task must implement the fallback. Also plan T022's circularity check (SC-001/SC-009) has no implementing task — the coverage table maps SC-001/SC-009 to 'target validation halt logic', which is not the residual-variance circularity test the plan requires.

T103 validates 'feature/VIF report against contracts/feature_schema.yaml' but names no concrete artifact file (e.g., data/processed/feature_vif_report.json) and no completed task is credited with producing a file in that schema's shape (features array with feature_name/importance_score/vif_score/is_excluded). T102's feature_importance.csv has only ['feature','importance_score'] and no vif_score/is_excluded columns, so it cannot satisfy feature_schema.yaml. Name the artifact and its producing task, or the validation step is unverifiable.
